name: claudeconnect
notes: No Claude subscription? Setup now asks, and on the free plan the Claude app answers instead of Claude Code: your message is typed into the app, with the model and extended thinking you pick, and the reply streams back as it's written.
Without the Claude app, Claude opens in its own window of Chrome, Edge, Brave or Chromium instead. Sign in to claude.ai there once. Works on Mac and Windows.
When Claude Code needs your permission (pick Ask first), or a window in the Claude app waits for an answer, the site dims and shows just that question, to allow or deny from any device.
Plan usage shows your free limit resets, daily or weekly, and when each limit resets. So does the note when you run out, with a button to use a reset.
A new look, closer to ChatGPT, colors included.
Settings now has everything the edit command has, and the other way round: your Claude plan, starting when you log in, the working folder, the theme, and the rest.
Everything runs as Claude Code: the switch between Claude and Claude Code is gone.
Fable 5.1 is in the model picker whenever you have usage credits to spend, and your credit balance is always shown. Their settings are gone.
The sidebar always lists every Claude Code chat on your computer, and the context circle only shows once a chat has started.
The theme is kept on the site, so it's the same on every device.
Bringing chats over from claude.ai's data export is gone, and chats brought over that way are removed from the site. They're still on claude.ai.
